execution: Pass the complete substituted statement array to one run_sql_transaction; no partial execution, no retries after a successful/unknown commit without read-only investigation.

__PREPARED_WORKSPACE_JSON_SQL_LITERAL__.meaning: An SQL-quoted JSON text literal containing apply_admin(None, prepared_record, database_user='preflight_owner') state; no raw application key.

__NEON_RUNTIME_PASSWORD_SQL_LITERAL__.meaning: One whole SQL-quoted literal for the original Neon runtime password, substituted by the authorized operator with psycopg.sql.Literal from a protected file. Never substitute a SCRAM verifier. Do not print or publish the password or composed SQL.

limits: No DB calls or secret file reads are performed by this preparer.
A valid application key plus runtime DSN exposes the full queue/receipts and can bypass Python queue semantics; this boundary protects auth state, not the entire blinded workflow.
The DB administrator retains management authority; never deploy that DSN as runtime.
The SQL logging guard observes this administrator session only. Review duration/audit/proxy logging separately; the original password supplied to CREATE ROLE and account hashes remain private.
A successful template build is not SQL execution, CI evidence, external approval or deployment evidence.
statements: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '3s'
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '15s'
SET LOCAL TimeZone = 'UTC'
SET LOCAL standard_conforming_strings = on
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext('preflight-team-init:preflight_team'))
SELECT pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext('preflight-team-api:preflight_team'))
CREATE SCHEMA "preflight_team" AUTHORIZATION "preflight_owner"
CREATE TABLE "preflight_team".workspace (singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK(singleton), revision bigint NOT NULL, document jsonb NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())

INSERT INTO "preflight_team".workspace(singleton,revision,document) SELECT true,(prepared.document->>'revision')::bigint,prepared.document FROM (SELECT __PREPARED_WORKSPACE_JSON_SQL_LITERAL__::jsonb AS document) prepared
CREATE ROLE "preflight_runtime" LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT PASSWORD __NEON_RUNTIME_PASSWORD_SQL_LITERAL__
CREATE ROLE "preflight_team_api_owner" NOLOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT
GRANT "preflight_team_api_owner" TO CURRENT_USER WITH INHERIT FALSE, SET TRUE GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE "preflight_team".workspace FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA "preflight_team" FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE "preflight_team".workspace FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON SCHEMA "preflight_team" FROM "preflight_runtime"
GRANT USAGE, CREATE ON SCHEMA "preflight_team" TO "preflight_team_api_owner"
GRANT SELECT, UPDATE ON TABLE "preflight_team".workspace TO "preflight_team_api_owner"
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA "preflight_team" TO "preflight_runtime"
SET LOCAL ROLE "preflight_team_api_owner"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_stamp"(text) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_stamp"(text) FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_state"(bigint,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_state"(bigint,jsonb) FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_command"(uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_command"(uuid,text) FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_auth"(jsonb,text,text) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_auth"(jsonb,text,text) FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_auth_delta"(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,timestamp with time zone) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."_api_auth_delta"(jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,jsonb,timestamp with time zone) FROM "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."lock_workspace"(text,uuid,text) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."lock_workspace"(text,uuid,text) FROM "preflight_runtime"
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."lock_workspace"(text,uuid,text) TO "preflight_runtime"
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."save_workspace"(text,uuid,text,bigint,jsonb) FROM PUBLIC
REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."save_workspace"(text,uuid,text,bigint,jsonb) FROM "preflight_runtime"
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION "preflight_team"."save_workspace"(text,uuid,text,bigint,jsonb) TO "preflight_runtime"
SET LOCAL ROLE "preflight_owner"
REVOKE CREATE ON SCHEMA "preflight_team" FROM "preflight_team_api_owner"
REVOKE "preflight_team_api_owner" FROM CURRENT_USER GRANTED BY CURRENT_USER

SELECT 1 / CASE WHEN (SELECT document FROM "preflight_team".workspace WHERE singleton=true) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM __PREPARED_WORKSPACE_JSON_SQL_LITERAL__::jsonb THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS prepared_state_matches

SELECT 'restricted_api_bootstrap_verified' AS status, revision, document->>'schema_version' AS schema_version, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='preflight_team'::regnamespace) AS api_function_count FROM "preflight_team".workspace WHERE singleton=true
